mapper.select: SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE SPEC_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, -- EMBRYO_VERSION BOM_VERSION,业务逻辑没用，MES中间表无此字段暂时去除 EMBRYO_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE CONSTRUCTION_CODE, TRIAL_STATUS, SPEC_DESC, EMBRYO_DESC AS MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, EMBRYO_NO, EMBRYO_TYPE, EMBRYO_RELEASE_DATE, TEXT_NO, TEXT_TYPE, TEXT_RELEASE_DATE, LH_NO, LH_TYPE, LH_RELEASE_DATE, IS_ZERO_DEGREE AS IS_ZERO_RACK, CURING_TIME, CURING_TIME2 HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME, CURING_TIME CURING_TIME2, CURING_TIME2 HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME2, DEL_FLAG IS_DELETE, FACTORY_CODE FROM LH_CONSTRUCTION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT EMBRYO_VERSION CONSTRUCTION_VERSION, EMBRYO_CODE MATERIAL_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE MES_MATERIAL_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE CONSTRUCTION_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE SPEC_CODE, -- 2026-1-23 水根说这个字段用物料号 EMBRYO_DESC EMBRYO_DESC, PATTERN, SPEC SPECIFICATIONS, FORMING_METHOD MOULD_METHOD, DRUM_TYPE BUILDING_DRUM_TYPE, RUBBER_PAD PADDING_CODE, SIDE_WALL SIDEWALL_CODE, WIRE_LOOP BEAD_CODE, RUBBER_CORE RUBBER_CORE_CODE, BEAD TIRE_RING_CODE, INNER_LINER INSIDE_CODE, ZERO_DEGREE ZERO_BELT_CODE, CLOTH_WRAPPING CLOTH_WRAPPING_CODE, CARCROSS TIRE_BODY_CODE, FIRST_LAYER BELT_CODE1, SECOND_LAYER BELT_CODE2, THREE_LAYER BELT_CODE3, FOUR_LAYER BELT_CODE4, LEFT_REINFORCE_LAYER BELT_CODE_LEFT_CODE, RIGHT_REINFORCE BELT_CODE_RIGHT_CODE, TYPE_GLUE TYPE_ADHESIVE_CODE, DEL_FLAG IS_DELETE, FACTORY_CODE, TREAD_CODE FROM MES_CONSTRUCTION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE, CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME, CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE, CHILD_CODE, CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION, UNIT, DOSAGE, DOSAGE_FORM, PARENT_MATERIAL_CODE, PARENT_MATERIAL_NAME, PARENT_CODE, PARENT_VERSION, PRODUCTION_STAGE, BOM_VERSION, REMARK, STATUS, CREATE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_BOM_INFO WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
